campaign.execution: serial; one throwaway server at a time
campaign.limitations: Replay scripts contain host-specific absolute paths and require adapting for another machine. Refusal stdout was not retained.
campaign.comparison: No baseline differential comparison was performed.
campaign.worker_method: The primary agent directed an adversarial-fuzz coordinator; it assigned focused deep, larger, refusal and partial probes serially. Follow-on forty-node and retitle runs used controlled serial probe scripts; a report agent rendered evidence. No probes ran concurrently.
campaign.historical_probe_limit: The earlier *-probe.py files are historical evidence, with absolute host-specific paths and raw unsorted dependency comparisons. They are not portable, reproducible CI tests.
campaign.sources: Frozen forty-node generator, guard and v2/v3 controllers and their hashes are in forty-node-evidence.zip and forty_node_gap.cases. Retitle sources and hashes are in retitle-evidence.zip and retitle_churn.hashes. Replacement sources in replacement-campaign-evidence.zip changed during the run: the final sources cannot exactly replay all earlier cases; retained per-case logs contain actual inputs and commands.
campaign.scale_status: PARTIAL: the lead-approved budget was 30 seeds × 40 nodes × 10 revisions. Five such seeds ran; explicit owner acceptance of the reduction is pending.
campaign.shared_server: Five initial 40-node setup attempts and the first replacement-run setup attempted the shared :3308 endpoint; access was denied. The lead checked and reported no shared beads were added. Historical server checks and current pgrep are recorded in forty_node_gap.post_run_servers.
campaign.coverage_gaps: Only the second mutation position was fault injected; embedded-mode, crash and concurrent probes were not performed. Retained trace is absent for 3 earlier refusal cases.
campaign.archive_verification: Independent archive evidence review at bf2f50fd: all three ZIP integrity checks passed; 90 replacement case assertions completed, 64 structural plus 30 refusal conflict responses = 94, 30 dangling, 30 dirty, 30 partial responses, five 40-node logs with 50 revision events, and four retitle revision events. Assertion relationships rely on imported integration_repour_fuzz.py and were not independently replayed. Four earlier logs have PASS markers; the three earlier refusal cases have no trace.

findings.expected_oracle: Equivalent dependency and edge order must compare equal, while a changed edge remains unequal.
findings.observed_result: Order-sensitive snapshot comparison flagged a mismatch when dependency order changed; this was a harness defect, not a confirmed product defect.
findings.fix: scripts/integration_repour.py canonical_snapshot_entry; deterministic regression in scripts/tests/test_integration_repour.py

replacement_campaign.harness_defect: Earlier seed 25001 exposed an order-sensitive dependency snapshot; this is a flaky test-harness oracle, not a confirmed product defect. Fixed in scripts/integration_repour.py with unit coverage.
replacement_campaign.initial_run: Initial shared-server run stopped on a formula-name harness setup error; a replacement server and database were started for the 90-case run. The initial error log was not retained.
replacement_campaign.coverage_limits: Lead-approved scale budget: 30 seeds × 40 nodes × 10 revisions. Replacement achieved 90 cases across structural, refusal and partial families, with a maximum structural case of 20 nodes and 6 revisions; the later gap round achieved five 40-node, 10-revision seeds. Only the second mutation was fault-injected. Embedded-mode, crash and concurrency probes were not performed.
replacement_campaign.evidence_note: Per-case inputs and command stdout/stderr captured in the zip; unrelated process-list records removed from orchestration and earlier structural logs. Final scripts changed during the run and cannot exactly reproduce every earlier case; earlier source versions unavailable. Host-specific paths and a historical deadline require adaptation.
